description: Open a daily puzzle: today's board for a game, or an older one by number. Shows an interactive board the user plays in the chat, plus a text version of the board and the rules.

date.description: The user's local date (YYYY-MM-DD), so "today" matches their day. Optional.

game.description: Which game, by id from list_games (for example "thunk").

number.description: Board number (No. 1 was the game's first day). Leave out for today's board.

name: play_game
title: Play a puzzle
